intro: Your personal comfort zone awaits with TuneIn. Wrapped in a comfortable fabric finish, this recliner lets you stretch, adjust, and recharge in style, turning every moment into your time to truly relax.

features.title: Recline the way you like
features.text: Motorized recline, headrest, and lumbar controls adapt to how you want to rest, so you always find your sweet spot whether it’s movie night or me-time.

features.title: Reset with one touch
features.text: No fiddling when you need to get up. One tap on the home button resets your chair upright, making transitions quick and effortless for you.

features.title: Support where you need it most
features.text: Your back and neck feel taken care of with adjustable lumbar and headrest support, so long hours in the chair stay comfortable and easy on you.

features.title: Charge while you relax
features.text: Keep your phone or tablet close and charged. With built-in USB-A and Type-C ports, you can unwind without worrying about running out of battery.

features.title: Made for your home
features.text: Sleek lines and a compact design make this recliner fit perfectly into your living room or bedroom without taking away space.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Tunein Motorised 1-Seater Fabric Recliner Chair With Usb Ports
